subject.title: fix(telegram): DM lane stays dead after a wedged handler keeps it guarded; escalate to a supervised gateway restart

question: Should an in-process channel wedge use the generic `ChannelAccountSnapshot.processRestartRequired` contract, or should Telegram request recovery through a narrower plugin-owned gateway seam?
rationale: Both shapes can implement the recovery, but adding a generic channel snapshot field establishes a reusable plugin API and policy contract that repository history and tests alone cannot authorize permanently.

options.title: Keep the generic contract
options.body: Retain the additive snapshot field, document its strict hard-process-boundary semantics, and share the actual restart-capability predicate with the process-respawn implementation.

options.title: Use a Telegram-owned seam
options.body: Replace the generic snapshot field with an injected Telegram recovery request if maintainers do not want every channel plugin to gain process-restart signaling authority.

recommendation.title: Keep the generic contract
recommendation.body: Retain the additive snapshot field, document its strict hard-process-boundary semantics, and share the actual restart-capability predicate with the process-respawn implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The available review history identifies this person most directly with the Telegram polling and guarded-lane lifecycle whose ownership boundary drives the decision.
